Vacancy for Accountants
Friday, 23 December 2022
4224 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the following posts which must reach the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by 20
th
January 2023.  Candidate must have registration with the local employment exchange,
copy of the same must be submitted along with the application.
Qualification (Common to all posts):
Graduation in Commerce a from recognized University in India or equivalent. Experience proficiency in operating the computerized system and should have dealt with the maintenance of Books of Accounts like cash book, ledger, journal, stock-books and the process of scrutiny of bills and pay bills, drawing salaries, should have adequate knowledge about Income Tax Laws, GST Laws, Provident Fund, Professional Tax, etc. He/She should also have knowledge of preparing a budget, drawing the profit/ loss accounts, balance sheet, etc
Account Officer/Chief Accountant:
A. Intermediate /C.A.Final
Experience
: 5 years for C.A. intermediate/C.A. Final and 12 years or more for Graduation in Commerce in an organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 50 Crores and above.
Senior Accountant
:
A. Intermediate /C.A.Final,
Experience
:  3 years for C.A. intermediate/C.A. Final and 8 years or more for Graduation in Commerce in an organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above.
Accountant
:
Experience
: 5 years or more for Graduation in Commerce in an organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above.
Pay Scale:
As admissible under the rules of the Kasturba Health Society
Age Limit
:      Between 18 to 38 years subject to admissible category.
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in the age.
2. Decision of the Selection Committee will be final.
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
